As a 3PL provider with dozens of partners, managing returns is a hectic process for Rocket Shippers. Dante Brittis, Product Manager and Director of Transportation, leads all outbound and inbound transportation, which includes processing returns and getting items back in stock. Every day, his team faced the daunting task of managing returns for over 70 clients with only manual data entry.

These manual processes also meant Rocket Shippers didn’t have important returns visibility. Dante’s team didn’t even know when shipments were going to show up at their warehouse, making it difficult to plan for upcoming returns proactively. They ended up with understaffed shifts when returns arrived and processing delays, upsetting customers.

The analytics also help Dante’s team identify trends and have a high-level view of their customers’ satisfaction. Granular insights, such as return reasons, product conditions, and damage photos, help Rocket Shippers address issues before they become problems for clients.

Novel: The Story of Two Boxes Arriving from the Printer
The novel finally arrived from the printer, and I opened the box roughly—no, wait, calm down, I opened it carefully so I could reuse the box.
Oh! This box is the second volume! The colors are beautiful. The name is correct! Ah, one mistake... well, it's a minor detail, I'll pretend I didn't see it! Yes!
The second volume is fine. What a relief.
Now, time to check the first volume immediately. I carefully opened the other box for reuse as well!
Second volume, check! Second volume, good. Hmm?
Huh... my brain is confused. I'm time-leaping. Time has gone back to before I opened the box.

Since the recent AMAN Trove specification changes, I have somehow ended up only doing Venus Orbs. This time, I used a Mars Orb I got from Records of Eminence and encountered this mean pattern, so I'm venting. (Did everyone know about this...?)
After seeing messages like this flickering by...
Even when it got down to the last two, both remained wooden boxes...!? And then I even got this taunting message.
Not knowing what was going on (confused) because it was my first time, I opened one of the last two wooden boxes and...
Reflecting on this, if the last two become wooden boxes, it might be better to open the gold box in the middle.
I have decided in my heart that I will never exchange for a Mars Orb again... (T_T)
